title: Becky G on her friendship with Karol G: "Our goal is to be the best versions of ourselves"
summary: Singer Becky G speaks with Gayle King about her tour with Karol G and the bond the two pop stars have formed. "We have a beautiful friendship," Becky G says, "one I'm really, really thankful for and one that I think throughout the years we've really earned with one another."
